exposure: Intravenous ephedrine for spinal anaesthesia-induced hypotension
Intravenous phenylephrine for spinal anaesthesia-induced hypotension
cohort: The study included 80 ASA I parturient undergoing elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Phenylephrine resulted in significantly higher APGAR scores at 1 minute, lower need for neonatal resuscitation, higher umbilical arterial pH, and less negative base excess compared to ephedrine.
